newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-INJURY RULES CORK OUT OF ASHES SERIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INJURY RULES CORK OUT OF ASHES SERIES.

text.p: England paceman Dominic Cork has been ruled out of the Ashes series after a specialist confirmed on Thursday he needs surgery on a groin injury.
The Derbyshire bowler is to have an operation on Tuesday and faces six weeks of recuperation.

Derbyshire's general manager Stewart Edwards said: "At least Dominic's injury has been diagnosed and action can be taken. He should be back in contention by early August, although he will not be rushed.
"We understand it is a similar problem to that suffered by (England soccer captain) Alan Shearer, who needed another operation after attempting a swift comeback."
The six-test England-Australia test series ends on August 25.
